claims.quote: `docs/docs.html` is what the docs build writes from the fragments and the core, as `bun run --cwd packages/site-runtime docs --check` says

says.statement: After editing a docs fragment or the core evaluator, rebuild docs/docs.html.

claims.quote: CI runs the check of the site's asset versions

says.statement: CI fails when the site's asset version hash is out of date

claims.quote: No file of the core imports a UI library

says.statement: Lion core has no UI-specific primitives; a UI is Lion plus a host environment that binds tags to components.

claims.quote: Every test file of the core writes its tests with @effect/vitest

says.statement: Write properties with it.prop or it.effect.prop from @effect/vitest, with Schemas or effect/Arbitrary generators as inputs

claims.quote: Most of the core's tests are properties, not tests with fixed example inputs

says.statement: New behavior gets property-based tests, not tests with fixed example inputs
